description: Generic air conditioner control. Holds the logic common to every unit and delegates the communication to an attached implementation block, which is the only part that knows a given brand or model.

inputs.name: Power
inputs.description: Switches the unit on when high and off when low

inputs.name: Mode
inputs.description: Operating mode: 0 - auto, 1 - heating, 2 - cooling, 3 - drying, 4 - fan only. A unit without the requested mode uses its closest equivalent.

inputs.name: Target temperature
inputs.description: Requested target temperature, limited to the configured range

inputs.name: Fan speed
inputs.description: Fan speed: 0 - auto, 1 - quiet, 2 - low, 3 - medium, 4 - high, 5 - powerful (boost). A unit with fewer steps uses its closest equivalent.

inputs.name: Vertical airflow
inputs.description: Vertical vane: 0 - auto, 1 - swing, 2 to 6 - fixed position from the highest to the lowest

inputs.name: Horizontal airflow
inputs.description: Horizontal vane: 0 - auto, 1 - swing, 2 to 6 - fixed position from the leftmost to the rightmost

inputs.name: Air cleaning
inputs.description: Enables the air cleaning feature of the unit (ionizer, streamer, plasma filter). Ignored by units without one.

outputs.name: Power
outputs.description: High when the unit is on. Reported by the unit when the implementation provides feedback, otherwise the commanded state.

outputs.name: Mode
outputs.description: Effective operating mode, using the same values as the mode input. Units that report their status resolve the auto mode into heating or cooling here.

outputs.name: Target temperature
outputs.description: Target temperature the unit works with, after the configured range has been applied

outputs.name: Fan speed
outputs.description: Fan speed the unit was asked for, using the same values as the fan speed input. No unit reports this back, so it is always the commanded value.

outputs.name: Vertical airflow
outputs.description: Vertical vane setting the unit was asked for, using the same values as the vertical airflow input. No unit reports this back, so it is always the commanded value.

outputs.name: Horizontal airflow
outputs.description: Horizontal vane setting the unit was asked for, using the same values as the horizontal airflow input. No unit reports this back, so it is always the commanded value.

outputs.name: Air cleaning
outputs.description: Air cleaning setting the unit was asked for. No unit reports this back, so it is always the commanded value.

outputs.name: Room temperature
outputs.description: Indoor temperature measured by the unit. -1000 when the unit does not report it.

outputs.name: Fault
outputs.description: 0 - no fault, -1 - unit unreachable, above 0 - unit specific error code

config.name: Minimum target temperature
config.description: Lower limit for the target temperature input. The unit may narrow it down further.

config.name: Maximum target temperature
config.description: Upper limit for the target temperature input. The unit may narrow it down further.

config.name: Refresh interval
config.description: How often the unit status is read, in seconds. Set to 0 to never read it, for example for units controlled over infrared.

config.name: Resend state on refresh
config.description: Sends the full state to the unit on every refresh instead of only after a change. Keeps units without feedback in sync after they were operated with their own remote control.

state.name: Reported power
state.description: Power state reported by the implementation block: -1 unknown, 0 off, 1 on

state.name: Reported mode
state.description: Mode reported by the implementation block, -1 when unknown

state.name: Reported target temperature
state.description: Target temperature reported by the implementation block, -1000 when unknown

state.name: Reported room temperature
state.description: Indoor temperature reported by the implementation block, -1000 when unknown

state.name: Reported fault
state.description: Fault reported by the implementation block

state.name: Last implementation result
state.description: Value returned by the last implementation call, published as a fault when the unit reports none

state.name: State sent
state.description: Set once the state has been accepted by the unit at least once

state.name: Sent power
state.description: Last power state accepted by the unit

state.name: Sent mode
state.description: Last mode accepted by the unit

state.name: Sent target temperature
state.description: Last target temperature accepted by the unit

state.name: Sent fan speed
state.description: Last fan speed accepted by the unit

state.name: Sent vertical airflow
state.description: Last vertical vane setting accepted by the unit

state.name: Sent horizontal airflow
state.description: Last horizontal vane setting accepted by the unit

state.name: Sent air cleaning
state.description: Last air cleaning setting accepted by the unit

state.name: Refresh timer active
state.description: Set while the refresh timer is pending
